scope: Current-source ARM64/QEMU build and isolated RPC worker import smoke

build.command: docker buildx build -f Dockerfile.kernel --platform linux/arm64 --target kernel --load --build-arg KOKONUT_CLICKHOUSE=false -t kokonut-kernel-rpc-arm64:local .

runtime.command: python3 -c import platform; from services.ingestion.rpc_worker import _snapshot_record; print(platform.machine()); print(_snapshot_record(...)[0]['token'])
runtime.snapshot_contract: deterministic synthetic balance snapshot constructed; token ETH

limitations: QEMU is code-only ARM64 execution evidence, not physical Raspberry Pi compatibility, performance, thermal, power-loss, storage, or network acceptance.
Migration 436 was independently exercised against disposable PostgreSQL 16; it was not replayed on ARM64 in this image smoke.
No worker database credential was provisioned, no schedule was persisted or activated, and the local candidate remains at migration 435.
